issues.detail: Blind classifier reverses expected vertical semantics for the near-diagonal pair: 315 is classified down and 225 up. Human inspection shows the pair remains visually coherent as up-left/down-left; this is a subtle gaze-elevation ambiguity, not a materially blocking direction failure.

Continuity QA reports an interior transparent span at 180 (y=171) plus area-ratio and center-shift outliers around 157.5↔180↔202.5. The visible sheet reads as intentional lower-body/leg negative space and a controlled front-facing transition, with no obvious broken silhouette.
